posts.title: Building a Personal Health Dashboard from Samsung Health
posts.description: Samsung Health has no public API, so I built an Android app that pulls Health Connect data to a server and a static dashboard I can share.

posts.title: I built a database bastion with no inbound ports. Is that actually secure?
posts.description: I built a no-inbound SSM bastion to reach a private RDS, then asked whether closing the ports actually made it secure. The real surface is IAM, not the network.

posts.title: How to share Nvidia GPUs that don’t support MIG and when vGPU isn’t an option
posts.description: How I used genv and Docker to soft partition Nvidia L40S GPUs without MIG or vGPU. A practical guide to sharing GPUs safely for small research groups.
